acceptance_criteria.criterion: All new public types documented in api-surface.md.
configuration.md shows both old and new SuiteConfig formats.
Template syntax docs explain target_<name> flag pattern.

summary: api-surface.md: Updated buildSuite() and buildPersona() signatures to include the optional registry?: TargetRegistry parameter (added by WP-003) with a two-registry limitation callout explaining why custom registries passed only to build() are invisible when these functions are called directly.
file-tree.md: Fixed built-in.ts description from 'vscode + claude-code targets' to 'vscode, claude-code, and deep-agents targets' to reflect all three built-in targets now registered.

template-syntax.md: Added target_deep_agents row to the built-in context variables table; updated 'Target Flags' prose from 2-target wording to 3-target wording; extended the flag derivation example to include deep-agents → target_deep_agents and a note on custom targets.

constraints.md: Replaced stale Section 5 ('contextFlags Not Yet Consumed') and stale Section 6 ('Custom-Target Frontmatter Fallback') with a single accurate Section 5 ('Target Registry Extensibility') that describes the implemented contextFlags spread, registry-based frontmatter resolution, and the two-registry limitation. Fixed the duplicate ### 6. numbering (Ledger Plugin section is now the only Section 6). AC-2 (file-tree.md src/targets/) was already present and correct. AC-3 (configuration.md outputDirs + deprecated fields) was already fully updated by WP-003 documentation pipeline.

comments.note: AC-3 (configuration.md) and the majority of AC-1 (api-surface.md Target Registry section) were already complete from the WP-003 documentation pipeline. This pass focused on the remaining gaps: registry? parameters in buildSuite/buildPersona signatures, target_deep_agents in template-syntax.md, the built-in.ts file-tree description, and the two stale constraints.md sections (5 and 6 rewrote to reflect WP-003 completion, with the duplicate section-6 numbering fixed).

docs/getting-started.md still uses outVscode/outClaudeCode in its tutorial example. The deprecated fields continue to work, so this is not a blocking gap — but a future pass should update it to demonstrate the outputDirs pattern for new readers (observed and documented previously by WP-003 documentation agent).
